card.title: Everything Is Sudden Death
card.instruction: Approach minor choices as elimination rounds where one wrong move ends the entire future.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose our picnic sandwich carefully. Pick badly and this is our last picnic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then both sandwiches get a chance to eliminate us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll taste them first. You can trust my choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now one bite decides whether I can ever trust you with lunch again.

mechanism: A makes sandwich selection a knockout test of future picnics and then future trust.
confusable: Unlike ordinary food anxiety, each proposed solution must become a decisive elimination condition.
comparison: S212-a converts tasting help into a trust trial; S212-b converts coordinated emoji choice into joint social elimination.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
